title: Stratified and grouped cross-validation splits
hints: Stratified: for each class, take its indices, shuffle them with rng.permutation, and deal them round-robin to the k folds (fold_of[idx[i]] = i % k). Every fold then gets n_c // k or n_c // k + 1 members of class c.
Keep one array fold_of of length N. Fold f's test set is np.flatnonzero(fold_of == f) and its train set is np.flatnonzero(fold_of != f); that makes coverage and disjointness automatic.

Group k-fold: count the samples per group, visit groups from largest to smallest, and put each one into the fold that currently has the fewest samples. A group lives in exactly one fold, so it can never appear in both train and test.
